master-circular-standardization-2020.note: IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/193/07/2020, 22 July 2020. 155 pages consolidating every standardization guideline in force at 31 March 2020, including the Arogya Sanjeevani standard product wording and the four lists.

cghs-om-2025-10-03.note: MIRROR, NOT THE ISSUING AUTHORITY. CGHS package rates as circulated by the Delhi Jal Board. The CGHS portal did not resolve and its replacement is banner-marked a test environment, so this is the closest to source that could be reached. The Ministry of Jal Shakti hosts the same list at mowr.nic.in/core/Circulars/2023/GA_12-06-2023_20.pdf, but that host sends an incomplete certificate chain and is not fetchable under verification.

modification-guidelines-2019.note: IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/176/09/2019, 27 September 2019. Replaces Annexure I of the 2016 standardization guidelines with Lists I-IV: the optional items a patient pays for, and the items subsumed into room charges, procedure charges and treatment costs.

hbp-2.2-user-guidelines.note: Health Benefit Package 2.2 master list, National Health Authority. Served from hem.nha.gov.in; the nha.gov.in path for the same file returns an HTML error page under a .pdf URL.
